name: Kyuri Park
title: Kyuri Park — Brand & Product Designer
description: Kyuri Park is a Brand & Product Designer in Chicago working across brand identity, typefaces, digital products, and physical objects.

paragraphs: I'm a Brand & Product Designer. I started in Industrial and Graphic Design, and drifted into UX and branding.

I work by trying things. I explore, see what breaks, build things, and keep going until it solves the problem. That has meant designing brand identities and typefaces, prototyping digital products and interfaces, and shaping physical objects, often with AI as part of how I build.
Based in Chicago. Studying HCI at DePaul University.
